title: Minimising and Denial (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to recognise denial and minimising behaviours that prevent accountability and harm children’s emotional safety.
learningOutcomes: Understand how denial affects children’s sense of safety.
Recognise the impact of minimising on partners and family stability.

modules.title: Avoidance in Fathering
modules.content: Explores denial and justification in parenting contexts.

modules.title: Impact on Children and Partner
modules.content: Shows how avoidance harms emotional safety.

modules.title: Practising Honesty
modules.content: Provides tools for truthful reflection and accountability.
